comment: She is very hard and expects a lot. But she is also a great professor and always makes class interesting. Take her if you love Psych
Dr. Lindgren's stat class is not an easy class, but she does her best t explain as clearly as she can. Although her class is pretty tough, she is there to help.

Dr. Lindgren is one of the best, if not the best, teacher in the U or R psychology department. If you want to learn interesting subject matter while truly growing as a student then take her class. There are few better and its worth all the time you will put into the course.

Dr. Lindgren is a terrible teacher. She expects her students to understand concepts that she has difficulty explaining herself. Attendance is mandatory but her power points make the material seem more confusing. Read the textbook and don't pay attention to her lectures and you'll be better off.
